entries.subject: GJ 1156: a corona derived from its 3 magnetic maps
entries.finding: The potential field of each map to degree 15, with its source surface at 2.5 radii, reproduces the map with an rms residual of 0% to 0%. X-ray luminosity 5.8 × 10^27 erg/s (2RXS J121900.4+110732, 3.49 arcsec from the star's Gaia position, stellar probability 0.9988); temperature 5.6 million kelvin, not measured: the temperature stars of this X-ray output have (Johnstone & Güdel (2015), A&A 578, A129); mass loss 1.0 times the Sun's, not measured: what the X-ray output suggests (Wood et al. (2021), ApJ 915, 37), uncertain by a factor of 5 or more. The wind passes the speed of sound 1.08 radii out.
